about: Negative examples only: what makes a portrait animate badly. Style is never a problem, and neither is framing: every example is made from one head-and-shoulders photo, but half-body and full-body shots pass too.

examples.problem: Part of the head is cut off by the photo's edge
examples.look_for: Forehead, crown, chin or ears outside the frame
examples.why_it_fails: The engine animates what it is given; a missing part of the face can't be invented and the clip looks cropped
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo with the whole head and some space above it
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: crop the base through the forehead (rows 334-1024)

examples.problem: The face sits near the edge of a wide photo
examples.look_for: A landscape photo with the face off-centre
examples.why_it_fails: The engine scales the short side to 512 and keeps only the centre square, so a face near the edge is cut or lost
examples.ask_creator: Use a square photo, or one with the face in the middle
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: base at the left edge of a 1600x900 landscape

examples.problem: The person is small in a large frame
examples.look_for: In the centre square, a face narrower than about a fifth of its width (half-body and full-body shots are fine when the face stays bigger than that)
examples.why_it_fails: The engine keeps the centre square at 512 px, so a small face ends up a few dozen pixels wide and loses its detail
examples.ask_creator: Use a closer photo, or one where your face takes up more of it
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: base scaled to 260 px on a 1600x900 canvas

examples.problem: Only the face, no hair outline or shoulders
examples.look_for: A face filling the whole frame
examples.why_it_fails: With no neck or shoulders the head floats, and head movement crops the face
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo that shows your head and shoulders
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: tight crop of the face only, no hair outline or shoulders

examples.problem: The head or camera is tilted
examples.look_for: Eyes not level, a slanted horizon or background
examples.why_it_fails: The avatar keeps the tilt for the whole conversation
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo taken straight on, with your head level
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: base rotated 20 degrees

examples.problem: The photo is too small or upscaled
examples.look_for: Fewer than 512 px on the short side, or visible blocks
examples.why_it_fails: The engine works at 512×512; a smaller or upscaled photo animates soft and smeared
examples.ask_creator: Use the original photo file, at least 512×512
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: base downscaled to 96 px and back up

examples.problem: The photo is out of focus or has motion blur
examples.look_for: Soft edges on the eyes and mouth
examples.why_it_fails: Lip sync needs a sharp mouth; blur becomes a smeared mouth
examples.ask_creator: Use a sharp photo; hold the camera still
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: gaussian blur, sigma 5

examples.problem: Heavy JPEG compression
examples.look_for: Blocky squares and colour smears, especially around the hair
examples.why_it_fails: Compression blocks around the mouth turn into flicker
examples.ask_creator: Use the original photo, not one saved from a chat app or social media
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: JPEG at ffmpeg's worst quantiser (-q:v 31) twice, at 256 px then 384 px

examples.problem: A photo of a screen or a printed photo
examples.look_for: Moiré lines, a slanted frame, a colour cast or glare
examples.why_it_fails: The patterns and distortion animate along with the face
examples.ask_creator: Use the original digital photo
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: keystone perspective, moire pattern and a blue cast

examples.problem: The face is washed out
examples.look_for: No detail in the skin, eyes or lips
examples.why_it_fails: With no contrast around the mouth the engine can't track it
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo in even, softer light
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: brightness +0.38, contrast 0.65

examples.problem: Backlit: a bright background and a dark face
examples.look_for: A silhouette, or a face much darker than what is behind it
examples.why_it_fails: The face has no detail to animate
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo with the light in front of you, not behind
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: light neutral background pushed to near-white (face area excluded), the person darkened to 17 percent

examples.problem: Strong coloured light
examples.look_for: Skin lit pink, blue or green, as on a stage
examples.why_it_fails: Colours carry into the avatar and look unnatural when it talks
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo in plain daylight or white light
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: magenta stage-light colour mix

examples.problem: A hard shadow across the face
examples.look_for: One half of the face much darker than the other
examples.why_it_fails: The dark half animates poorly and the shadow doesn't move with the face
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo with even light on both sides of your face
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: left half of the image darkened to 18 percent

examples.problem: A collage, grid or before/after image
examples.look_for: More than one copy of the photo, panels or borders
examples.why_it_fails: The engine treats the whole image as one face
examples.ask_creator: Use a single photo
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: 2x2 grid of the base with flips and colour changes

examples.problem: Filters or AR stickers on the face
examples.look_for: Cartoon ears, noses, sparkles, or skin smoothed by a beauty filter
examples.why_it_fails: Stickers don't move with the mouth and filters change the face
examples.ask_creator: Use the photo without filters or stickers
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: cartoon ears, a pink nose and cheek dots painted over the face

examples.problem: Another face in the photo
examples.look_for: A second person, a face on a poster or screen, a reflection
examples.why_it_fails: The engine has no idea which face is meant and may animate the wrong one
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo with only you in it
examples.source: scripts/negative-examples/build.sh: a second generated face composited in the top-right corner

examples.problem: Something covers the mouth
examples.look_for: A hand, cup, phone, mask or scarf over the lips or jaw
examples.why_it_fails: The mouth is what gets animated; a covered mouth smears or freezes
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo where nothing is in front of your mouth
examples.source: generate_portraits (gemini): an invented woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater, plain light grey background, with her hand raised covering her mouth

examples.problem: An object in front of the chin or lips
examples.look_for: A microphone, pen or glass near the mouth
examples.why_it_fails: Objects near the mouth warp as the lips move
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo with nothing near your mouth
examples.source: generate_portraits (openai): an invented woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater, plain light grey background, holding a handheld microphone right in front of her mouth

examples.problem: Hair covers part of the face
examples.look_for: Hair across an eye, the cheek or the side of the mouth
examples.why_it_fails: Covered parts animate badly and hair smears when the head moves
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo with your hair away from your face
examples.source: generate_portraits (gemini): an invented woman in her early 30s with long dark brown hair falling across her face and covering one eye and part of her cheek, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater, plain light grey background

examples.problem: A beard or moustache hides the lips
examples.look_for: Upper or lower lip not visible
examples.why_it_fails: Without visible lips the mouth movement smears into the beard
examples.ask_creator: If you can, use a photo where your lips are visible; otherwise try it, and judge the seeds carefully
examples.source: generate_portraits (novita): an invented man in his early 30s with a very thick, bushy full beard and a heavy moustache that completely covers his lips, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater, plain light grey background

examples.problem: Sunglasses or glasses with strong glare
examples.look_for: Eyes not visible behind dark or mirrored lenses
examples.why_it_fails: Eyes can't blink or look around, so the avatar looks frozen
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo without sunglasses, or with clear glasses and no glare
examples.source: generate_portraits (openai): an invented woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater and dark mirrored sunglasses with a bright reflection, plain light grey background

examples.problem: A hat shades the eyes
examples.look_for: The eyes in shadow under a brim
examples.why_it_fails: The shaded eyes can't blink or move naturally
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo without the hat, or with your eyes in the light
examples.source: generate_portraits (novita): an invented woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater and a wide-brimmed hat pulled low that casts a dark shadow over her eyes, plain light grey background

examples.problem: A strong expression
examples.look_for: Mouth wide open, eyes squeezed shut, shouting
examples.why_it_fails: The avatar starts every clip from this face and can't relax out of it
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo with a relaxed face and a slight smile
examples.source: generate_portraits (novita): an invented woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater, plain light grey background, laughing hard with her mouth wide open and eyes squeezed shut

examples.problem: Tongue out or a pulled face
examples.look_for: The tongue or teeth in an unusual position
examples.why_it_fails: The mouth shape is baked in and lip sync can't close it
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo with a relaxed face and a slight smile
examples.source: generate_portraits (novita): an invented woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater, plain light grey background, playfully sticking her tongue out

examples.problem: Eyes looking away from the camera
examples.look_for: Eyes turned to the side, up or down
examples.why_it_fails: The avatar never looks at the person it talks to
examples.ask_creator: Use a photo where you look straight into the camera
examples.source: generate_portraits (novita): an invented woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a plain teal crew-neck sweater, plain light grey background, her eyes looking far off to the side and up, not at the camera
